prompt_metadata.app_name: CatLog Diary - Advanced Feline Health Tracker & Care Scheduler
prompt_metadata.tagline: Log litter habits, monitor weight curves, and secure medication intervals.
prompt_metadata.architecture_pattern: MVVM + Clean Architecture + MVI for Log & Scheduler States
prompt_metadata.monetization: Hybrid: Free (Log up to 2 cats, standard weight log entry, basic litter notifications + AdMob Banner/Interstitial Ads) | Premium Pro ($3.99/mo subscription or $19.99 lifetime purchase to unlock unlimited cat profiles, high-fidelity dynamic weight/health canvas charts, multi-device cloud sync, automated smart medication notification loops, vet report PDF exports, and an ad-free clean experience)

agent_instructions.role: You are a Principal Android Engineer and Pet Care Technical Architect. Your goal is to design 'CatLog Diary', a highly optimized, offline-first application for dedicated cat owners to capture litter-box events, visualize precise multi-cat weight curves, monitor food/water intake logs, and guarantee strict medication schedules with low-latency responsiveness.
agent_instructions.design_philosophy: Gentle, clean, and highly intuitive. Feline healthcare tracking requires zero-friction data entry so users can log events in a single hand tap. The user interface must feature soft, warm palettes, cat-inspired visual tokens, fluid animation transitions, and clear analytical charts that prioritize diagnostic readability for vet consultations.
code_standards: Strict Clean Architecture boundaries: Presentation (Compose UI, ViewModels, MVI Intents), Domain (Feline Health UseCases, Analytics Math Rules, Notification Contracts), and Data (Room DB with dynamic schema migrations, DataStore, AlarmManager wrappers).
Dynamic MVI state tracking utilizing Kotlin StateFlows to keep UI charts, medication progress checklists, and weight sliders synchronized across tabs.
Reliable local notification scheduling using Android's AlarmManager combined with WorkManager for persistent medication/insulin alarms.
Optimized offline-first storage utilizing Room, maintaining high-resolution logs, timeline events, and local media attachments (symptom photos) without blocking the UI main thread.

multi_cat_profile_engine.description: Manage individual feline health baselines securely in isolated data containers.
features: Dynamic Cat Registration: Support logging breed (loaded from local JSON), birthdate, gender, microchip ID, sterilization status, and activity baseline.
Profile Avatar Processor: Build an interactive image selection and circular cropper tool, saving optimized profile thumbnails directly to local app storage.

litter_box_tracker_engine.description: Log, categorize, and flag litter-box patterns to identify early signs of FLUTD or other urinary anomalies.
features: Granular Event Logging: Capture urine/stool markers with consistency scales (Bristol Stool Chart adapted for cats), relative volume sliders, and dynamic anomaly indicators (blood presence, excessive straining).

Automated Anomaly Flags: Write domain-level rules that analyze temporal frequency anomalies (e.g., logging urine events >4 times in 12 hours) and fire highly visible, non-alarmist health suggestions to consult a veterinarian.

precision_weight_analytics_curve.description: Custom-rendered, interactive spline graphs tracking subtle weight deviations crucial for feline disease detection.
charts: Feline Weight Trend: A smooth cubic spline line chart displaying weight fluctuations over weekly, monthly, and yearly intervals.
Feline BMI & Target Range: Draw visual boundary bands on the canvas representing the cat's target weight range, calculating percentage losses or gains interactively.
Log Distribution: A segmented radial donut chart mapping food intake types (Dry, Wet, Raw, Treats).

medication_and_insulin_scheduler.description: An iron-clad, exact alarm manager tracking life-critical feline medications.
features: Exact Alarm Dispatcher: Inject recurring exact alarms utilizing Android's AlarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle to guarantee critical insulin or thyroid notifications fire on time.
Compliance Checklist: Create daily calendar sheets with touch-interactive checkboxes that log doses administered, logging metadata (dosage, administrator, and timestamp) in Room.

admob_monetization_layer.banner_ads: Collapsible smart banners integrated at the bottom of the History Log and Analytics Dashboard screens (suppressed in Pro).
admob_monetization_layer.interstitial_ads: Triggered gracefully after successfully adding a new weight log or litter-box event (frequency capped to 1 ad per 10 minutes to protect the user experience).
admob_monetization_layer.rewarded_ads: Watch an ad to unlock high-resolution veterinary PDF exports or premium food nutrition analyzers for 24 hours.
admob_monetization_layer.consent_platform: Integrate the Google User Messaging Platform (UMP) SDK to handle fully compliant, international GDPR and ePrivacy consent loops.

key_permissions: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES (Required for choosing profile pictures and logging symptom photos on SDK 33+)
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS (Crucial to fire medication and health reminder alerts on SDK 33+)
android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM (Required for scheduled critical insulin alarms on Android 13+)
android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM (Required for Android 14+ policies on medication-specific scheduling)
android.permission.INTERNET (For processing Google Play Billing, loading AdMob ads, and syncing databases)

module_architecture.app: Application initialization, Hilt module graphs, dynamic provider bindings, and safe NavHost controllers.
module_architecture.core_ui: Feline-focused design tokens (Warm Salmon Pink, Soft Calico Cream, Cool Mint Green), custom path charts, and spring animation interpolators.
module_architecture.feature_profile: Profile creator views, breed dictionaries, avatar croppers, and local storage picture repositories.
module_architecture.feature_tracker: Litter-box logging sheets, food/water calculators, symptom photo binders, and anomaly logic checkers.
module_architecture.feature_scheduler: AlarmManager receivers, recurring interval calculators, dosage logs, and completion checkers.
module_architecture.feature_analytics: Custom Canvas charts (feline weight splines, food segment rings), vet-ready PDF exporter engines, and data CSV builders.
module_architecture.feature_pro: Google Play Billing 6.x wrappers, dynamic tier comparison widgets, premium widget builders, and paywall screens.

ui_ux_design.design_notes: A calming, warm cat-themed dark mode is available ('background': '#121B20', 'surface': '#1C2930', 'on_surface': '#ECEFF1'). Spacing must prioritize wide tap targets (minimum 48dp) for rapid, single-handed input while handling cats.

execution_roadmap.description: Establish multi-module structure utilizing clean architecture guidelines. Scaffold Hilt containers, set up Kotlin Version Catalogs, prepare Type-Safe Compose Navigation routes, and initialize Room schema structures for cats, litter habits, weights, and medications.
Implement the cat registration flow. Develop an asynchronous image selection, compression, and scaling pipeline to generate profile avatars and save paths inside the Room database schema safely.

Develop the litter-box logging sheets. Write local domain evaluators to track daily frequency thresholds, dynamic consistency flags, and trigger diagnostic flags to warning panels if threshold limits are breached.

execution_roadmap.phase_4: Weight Trends: Custom Canvas Spline Charts
execution_roadmap.description: Build high-performance, clean-code mathematical coordinate drawing utilities on standard Jetpack Compose Canvas. Render dynamic weight lines, cubic splines, range indicators, and segmented food consumption donut rings with interactive tooltips.

Develop the exact alarm scheduling engine. Hook into AlarmManager with strict Android 13/14 permissions compliance. Orchestrate localized push notifications linked to dose event checkers to ensure high compliance with medication windows.

Initialize the Google User Messaging Platform (UMP) SDK. Construct modular Compose container overlays to request location/privacy consent loops before initializing the AdMob SDK. Inject responsive Anchor adaptive Banners and custom-capped Interstitial triggers.

Build the Google Play Billing subscription repository. Construct a modern, visually striking Pro Paywall featuring dynamic cards, comparison grids, and spring transition animations that bypasses AdMob overlays upon transaction validation.

execution_roadmap.phase_8: Performance Tuning, CSV Exporter & Store Preparation
execution_roadmap.description: Measure and optimize database fetch times for high-volume logs. Implement vet-ready CSV and PDF data export pipelines. Profile garbage collection behavior during Canvas weight spline renderings and build the signed production release bundle.
